# VHTC

> VHTC is a free online learning hub providing comprehensive study materials, handwritten notes, and exam preparation resources for NEET and JEE aspirants.

VHTC offers structured educational content across biology, physics, and medical sciences with a focus on competitive exam preparation. The platform provides handpicked study notes, detailed topic guides, and practical learning materials for students preparing for national-level entrance exams.

## Key Topics

- NEET preparation
- JEE preparation
- Biology notes
- Study materials
- Cell biology
- Biological classification
- Flowering plants
- Animal kingdom
- Plant kingdom
- Biomolecules
- Cell cycle
- Human anatomy
- PDF study guides
- Handwritten notes
- Competitive exams

## Biology Study Materials

- [The Living World - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/the-living-world-biology-handpicked.html): Living World notes: binomial nomenclature, Monera, Protista, Fungi kingdoms
- [Biological Classification - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/biological-classification-biology.html): Biological Classification notes: taxonomy, Five Kingdom, binomial nomenclature
- [Plant Kingdom - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/plant-kingdom-biology-handpicked-short.html): Plant Kingdom notes: Algae, Fungi, Mosses, Liverworts classification
- [Animal Kingdom - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/animal-kingdom-biology-handpicked-short.html): Animal Kingdom notes: Porifera, Cnidaria, Platyhelminthes phyla
- [Cell: The Unit of Life - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/cell-unit-of-life-biology-handpicked.html): Cell biology: Cell Theory, DNA, prokaryotic & eukaryotic cells
- [Cell Cycle and Division - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/cell-cycle-and-division-biology.html): Cell Cycle: Interphase, Mitotic phase, G1 phase, DNA replication
- [Biomolecules - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/biomolecules-biology-handpicked-short.html): Biomolecules: carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids

## Plant & Animal Anatomy

- [Morphology of Flowering Plants - Biology Handpicked Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/morphology-of-flowering-plants-biology.html): Flowering Plants morphology: angiosperms, plant organs & structure
- [Anatomy of Flowering Plants - Biology Handpicked Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/anatomy-of-flowering-plants-biology.html): Flowering Plants anatomy: tissues, vascular system, roots, stems, leaves
- [Structural Organisation in Animals - Biology Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/structural-organisation-in-animals.html): Animal structure: organization levels, tissues, organs, body symmetry
- [Transport in Plants - Biology Handpicked Short Notes PDF](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/09/transport-in-plants-biology-handpicked.html): Plant transport: Xylem, Phloem, Tracheids, transpiration mechanisms
- [Mineral Nutrition Biology Short Notes PDF Download](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/10/mineral-nutrition-biology-handpicked.html): Mineral Nutrition: macronutrients, micronutrients, nutrient deficiency

## Human Physiology & Health

- [Human Heart - Tips for a Healthy Heart](https://www.vhtc.org/2024/11/human-heart.html): Human heart anatomy, cardiovascular health, cardiac cycle & heart tips
- [Parathyroid Gland Disorders - Hyperparathyroidism vs Hypoparathyroidism—Causes, Symptoms, Labs, and Treatment](https://www.vhtc.org/2025/09/parathyroid-gland-disorders-hyperparathyroidism-hypoparathyroidism.html): PTH disorders guide: hyperparathyroidism & hypoparathyroidism with labs

## Physics Study Materials

- [Class 11 Physics Notes PDF | Handwritten Short Notes](https://www.vhtc.org/2025/01/class-11-physics-handwritten-notes-pdf.html): Class 11 Physics handwritten notes: Newton's Laws, Gravitation, Work-Energy
